tei:div.tei:p: "!#ྈྈ gsang sngags spyi chings kyi gdams ngag zab mo them yig med pa'i skor las: rtsa gsum bla rdo srog tig yongs 'dus zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ rtsa ba gsum gyi lha la phyag 'tshal lo: gsang sngags spyi chings sgrub pa'i gdams ngag gnad: rtsa gsum bla rdo srog thig yongs 'dus mchog: bstan pas gang dang 'brel yang kha bsgyur gces: mang du mi spel snying gi phur du chongs: sa ma ya: rgyaḥrgyaḥrgya: dang po bla ma'i srog 'khor bri ba ni: gza' tshes bzang bar shog shog gtsang ma la: gser ram mtshal sogs rin chen rigs sbyangs la: mu khyud gsum bskor lte bar oṃ āḥhūm̐: rim bzhin dkar dmar mthing gsum ma nor brtsegs: de yi rgyab tu 'di nyid bskor bar bya: ho: rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla ma: rig 'dzin brda' brgyud bla ma: gang zag snyan brgyud bla ma: drin chen rtsa brgyud bla ma: sku gsum bka' brgyud bla ma: smon lam dbang brgyud bla ma: mkha' 'gro gtad brgyud bla ma: mdor na bla na med pa'i bla ma rnams thugs dam ma g.yel bar: 'dir gshegs shing bzhugs nas bdag che ge byin gyis brlab cing dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol ba dang: phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par mdzad du gsol lo: de rgyab dmigs bsal gang yin snying po rnams: bri zhing de rgyab 'khor rtsibs bcu drug bya: dbus der 'bru gsum brtsegs mthar 'di re re bri: sangs rgyas kun 'dus sku gsum bka' brgyud bla mas dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol cig: de rgyab mu khyud sngags 'di bri bar bya: oṃ badz+ra bid+yā s+ya sid+dhi āḥhūm̐ dza: oṃ rat+na bid+yā s+ya sid+dhi āḥhūm̐ dza: oṃ pad+ma bid+yā s+ya sid+dhi āḥhūm̐ dza: oṃ karma bid+yā s+ya sid+dhi āḥhūm̐ dza: oṃ bud+dha bid+yā s+ya sid+dhi āḥhūm̐ dza: oṃ kā ya badz+ra sid+dhi āḥhūm̐: oṃ wā ka badz+ra sid+dhi āḥhūm̐: oṃ tsit+ta badz+ra sid+dhi āḥhūm̐: oṃ dzñā na badz+ra sid+dhi āḥhūm̐: oṃ ā yu sid+dhi āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbh+rūm̐: oṃ pu ṇ+ya sid+dhi āḥhūm̐ bh+rūm̐: oṃ ma hā mu drā sid+dhi āḥhūm̐ ā:

oṃ karma tsa tur sid+dhi āḥhūm̐ swa āḥha: de la gang shong bri ba gces pa yin: de rgyab mu khyud sngags 'di gang shong bri: oṃ sarba bud+dha ā we sha ya hriṃ dza: oṃ gu ru dharmā kā ya sarba ā we sha ya hriṃ dza: oṃ gu ru sam+bho kā ya sarba ā we sha ya hriṃ dza: oṃ gu ru nirma kā ya sarba ā we sha ya hriṃ dza: oṃ bo dhi satwa sarba ā we sha ya hriṃ dza: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta gu ṇa karma hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥpheṃ pheṃ hriṃ hriṃ ā kar sha ya dza: ā kar sha ya hriṃ: sarba tiṣ+ṭha lhan lhan ye swā hā: de rgyab ā li kā li gang shong dang: de rgyab rten 'brel snying po gang shong bri: dar 'bru rin chen sman dri lnga tshan lnga: chos sman gang bzang lte bar bzhag par bya: phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: sprul sku'i cha lugs mtshan dpes rab mdzes bskyed: thams cad thams cad rab byung sngags chas dang: grub thob cha lugs byang sems dge 'dun tshogs: longs sku rab byung kun kyang zhi tshul bsgom: dmigs pas yang yang gsal gdab khyad par du: gang yin bla ma gtso la 'khor rnams bskor: 'ja' 'od thig le thig phran lhun sdug nang: byin rlabs 'thibs se dmigs la mos gus kyis: gsol gdab spyan 'dren yang yang byas la bstim: rab gnas yang bskyar dar sna'i na bza' gsol: sa mā ya: rgya rgya rgya: gnyis pa yi dam bla rdo srog 'khor ni: bri rdzas gong mtshungs mu khyud rim bdun bskor: lte bar yi dam yab yum kha sbyor ram: yab rkyang yum rkyang gang yin thugs srog bri: phyogs bzhir 'khor rnams so so'i gzhung dang dpag: so so'i srog dang pho mo kha sbyor dang: rkyang par ra tsa hri ya pho bkod la: ha ri ni sa mo yig bkod par bya: de phyi'i mtha' skor 'di ni tshag med bri: kyai ho: yi dam pho mo gang yin 'khor bcas mtshan dang: khyed rnams dang gzhan yang theg pa rim dgu dang 'brel ba'i yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams pho rgyud mo rgyud rnams 'khor bcas kyis bdag la brtse bar dgongs nas 'dir gshegs shing bzhugs la sgrub po che ge la byin gyis brlab pa dang:

dbang yongs rdzogs su bskur nas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma g.yel bar myur du stsol cig: nad gdon mi shis mi rung ba mtha' dag zhi zhing bsam dgu char ltar phob cig: 'ja' lus mkha' spyod tshe 'di'am bar dor 'grub par mdzad du gsol: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las lhun gyis grub mdzad gsol lo: de rgyab mu khyud yi dam pho mo dag: gang yin 'khor bcas sngags dang 'di bkod do: tsaka shu tser ldan guṃ: sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ a nṛ tri tsit+ta ā kar+sha ya dza: ā kar+sha ya hring: kun la sbyar zhing de rgyab rtsibs bcu drug: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā:rnams tho brtsegs bri: de mthar 'di ltar bskor ba re re bya: yi dam lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pas bdag la dbang skur byin gyis rlobs dngos grub stsol cig: de rgyab 'di nyid tshag med bkod par bya: ho: yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams gnas yul dpa' bo mkha' 'gro zhi rgyas dbang drag la gtogs pa'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis bdag gi sgo gsum byin gyis brlabs nas: lus 'ja' lus: ngag nus ldan: sems chos sku: phung khams skye mched lha yi rang bzhin du bsgyur la khyed rnams dang dgongs pa mnyam par byin gyis rlobs: mi mthun kun zhi zhing tshe bsod chos mchog rgyas pa dang: snang srid dbang 'dus gnod byed tshar gcod pa'i dngos grub stsol cig: rtsa rlung thig gsum 'byongs nas sku gsum rang sa zin sku bzhi dang 'du 'bral med par mdzad du gsol: de rgyab yi dam pho mo 'khor dang bcas: gang yin so so'i sngags mthar 'di sbyar bskor: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta dzñā na pra we sha ya ho: ā kar sha ya dza: ā kar sha ya hring: pheṃ pheṃ hring hring dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥtiṣ+ṭha lhan: lha grangs nyung na mang du bskyar la bri: de rgyab snang ba dbang sdud 'di bri 'o: oṃ mu le lhod lhod sdus sdus ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ tri du tri du ma du ma du chum chum krog krog sarba sid+dhi ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya hūm̐ phaṭa:

oṃ spur spur: spur ye spur ye: na 'ong na 'ong ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭa: ra tsa hri ya ha ri ni sa ye a r+nṛ tri ā kar sha ya hring pheṃ dza: ha ri ni sa r+nṛ rū pa snying na sā re hūm̐ dza: zhes dang phyi pa mu stegs pa ma yin pa'i: dar sna lnga dang zhing lpags na bza' gsol: rang gzhung bskyed bstim rgyas dang rab gnas 'bad: mkha' 'gro ma kun 'di yi khongs su 'dus: sa ma ya: rgyaḥrgyaḥrgya: gsum pa chos skyong bla rdo spyi khog ni: ro ras sogs la rin chen rigs kyis bri: 'khor lo mu khyud bdun bskor lte ba ru: chos skyong pho mo gang yin srog bri la: mthar ni chos skyong gang yin mtshan gyi mthar: khyed 'khor dang bcas pa bdag sgrub pa che ge la lus dang grib ma lta bur 'grogs nas ci ltar bcol ba'i phrin las thogs med du sgrubs shig: sngon gyi dam bca' gnyan po ma snyel cig: rgyal ba sras bcas rig 'dzin gong ma rnams ma bslu bar 'dir gshegs la bzhugs nas gang bcol mdzad du gsol: de rgyab chos skyong 'khor bcas bsnyen pa dang: 'bod rbad sngags mthar spel tshig 'di yang bri: rnal 'byor bdag la 'tshe ba'i bgegs zlog nas dgra srog dmar po chod cig: ces dang de rgyab rtsibs bcu drug bya: de la: hūm̐ bh+yo raṃ e dzaḥtri rnams: tho brtsegs bris mthar 'di nyid bris la bskor: chos skyong pho rgyud mo rgyud 'khor bcas bdag la 'dus nas phrin las sgrubs shig: de rgyab mu khyud la ni 'di bri'o: dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra ā kar sha ya dza: ā kar sha ya hring: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta hring hring dzaḥdzaḥpheṃ: pra we sha ya ho ho tiṣ+ṭha lhan: sa ma ya hūm̐ sa ma ya ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: ho: rgyal ba gong ma rnams kyi spyan sngar sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung zhing sgrub po bu ltar skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chos skyong rnams sngon gyi dam tshig gnyan po dran par mdzod la bdag sgrub po che ge la lus dang grib ltar 'grogs nas:

phrin las gang bcol mdzad cing rtags dang mtshan ma ston cig: zhi ba dang rgyas pa dbang drag po sogs ci ltar bcol ba mdzod cig: bdag kyang dam la mi 'da' zhing khyod kyang dam la ma 'da' zhig: mchog gsum rgyal ba zhi khro dpang du bzhugs so: dam chu gnyan po dran par mdzad 'tshal lo: badz+ra sa ma ya na ra kan si hūm̐: de rgyab chos skyong gang yin sngags re'i mthar: 'di dang sbrags pa ci rigs bri bar bya: badz+ra sa ma ya tsit+ta ā kar sha ya hring dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.e h+ye hi hūm̐ dza pheṃ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: de rgyab rbad gsad sngags gang yod kyi mthar: bdag che ge la gnod pa'i dgra bo thams cad kyi rnam shes skem par mdzod cig: sha rus phung khams mā ra ya khā hi khā hi dgra bo'i srog la ya yā: de rgyab ye dhar dbyangs gsal legs par bri: mthun pa'i sha khrag rus snying la sogs dang: srung ba'i dam rdzas mthun kun bzhag par bya: slar yang srung ma'i rang gzhung ltar bris la: 'di dang mnyam bzhag zab pa'i mthar thug yin: yang na so so'i bla rdo shes pa 'am: ma shes pha wang long bur rang srog bri: rang mthun rdzas bcas bzhag nas mnyam du dril: rang mdog dar la srog sngags bris pas dril: de rgyab yi dam sku gzugs sngags bris pa: bskyed bstim rab gnas tshar ba'i dus su dril: sa ma yā: rgyaḥrgyaḥrgya: de nas de dag spyi khyab zhal gdams bshad: rang rang gtso bo'i sku gzugs tshon gang dang: srog sngags dar la gser gyis legs bris pa: dam rdzas ril bu byas par srog yig bri: de gsum lhan cig kun la bzhag pa gnad: gab tse sogs la gzhug nas phyi pho brang: nang ni gang yin lhar gsal bskyed bstim sogs: dus bzang kun la ma chag yang yang bya: mchod bstod dngos 'byor yid sprul ci rigs 'bad: rtag tu gang yin lha yi nges shes bya: rang sngags bzlas shing me tog 'thor ba gnad: rang gis 'chang ngam rten la gzhug pa sogs: skabs babs shes bya rtsa ba gsum sogs ni:

bya rgod ro 'dus lta bur yong nas ni: phrin las gang bcol 'grub pa'i gnad 'di zab: lar ni rang gis dam tshig bsrung gal che: sa ma ya: rgyaḥrgyaḥrgya: ye shes chos skyong bla rdo khyad par ni: gzhan bstan dregs pa spyi yi bla rdo bshad: dang po sde dpon bco brgyad bla rdo ni: pha wang long bur sre mong khrag gis bri: tri'u dza: sre mo'i snying nang gzhug la dar mthing dril: sngon dmar skud pas bcings la gnas su bcang: : le brgan dar la de pho'i khrag gis bri: dza sa ti rā hu la dza: zangs phur sor bzhi lhan cig de pho yi: snying nang dar dmar dril bcug sngo dmar skud: kyis bcings bcang ba gza' yi bla rdo 'o: : mthing nag dar la rin chen mtshal gyis bri: du du dza: kyung ka'i snying nang chu shing phur bu dang: lhan cig dar nag dril bcug sngon dmar bcings: bcang ba 'di ni bdud kyi bla rdo 'o: : dar dmar steng du ra khrag gis bri'o: tsa tsa tsa ra tsa: skyes phur lhan cig dar dmar dril nas ni: rta snying nang gzhug btsan gyi bla rdo 'o: : dar dmar steng du de pho dkar khrag gis: bris nas byi la'i snying dang lhan cig tu: shel dkar bzhag nas za 'og dkar pos dril: bcang ba de ni rgyal po'i bla rdo yin: rā tsa sha ṭa tri dza: : dar dkar steng du g.yag dkar khrag gis bri: a dhe wa tsakra dza: g.yag dkar snying gzhug yul lha'i bla rdo yin: : bya mo nag mo'i pags par de pho yi: khrag gis bris nas de yi snying nang gzhug: ma ma ru lu ru lu bh+yo dza: trag rak+sha dza: seng ldeng phur dang lhan cig dar nag dril: bcang ba ma mo kun gyi bla rdo yin: : sbrul gyi pags par nya yi khrag gis bri: phu nā ga rā tsa hūm̐ dza: nā ga nā gi phu tsit+ta hring dza: nya mgo'i nang gzhug gla rkang phur bu dang: lhan cig dar sngon dril bcang klu yi 'o: : dar gyi steng du gser gyis yi ge bri: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na: shel dang btsan rdo pha wang long bu gsum:

gser gzi rin chen bzhi dang chu yi rdo: dang bcas mthun rdzas lhan cig lcags phur sogs: bcang ba lha srin sde brgyad bla rdo yin: sa ma yā: rgyaḥrgyaḥrgya: gang zhig sngags pa nang 'gras byung ba 'am: las ma grub pa 'khu ldog byung ba sogs: 'u thug shin tu gnyan pa'i bya thabs bshad: mang du byas na rang srog chad par nges: des na tshod yod bu yis nyams su longs: las mgon la sogs gnad dbab shi sa ni: brub khung nang du gzugs dang bla rdo bzhag: thun gzir de nas mdzo mo shing me sbar: dug shing tsher can ma rungs pa yang bzhag: mi khyi'i brun bsreg dud bdug gzugs mgo mjug: bzlog nas rang nyid yi dam nga rgyal gyis: thun rdzas slar yang brab la 'di bzlas so: kā la he ru pa ya raṃ: yaṃ haṃ raṃ sa ma ya kā la srog la raṃ raṃ: : dam sri pho mo shi sa gnad dbab ni: dar dmar steng du dug khrag gis 'di bri: oṃ badz+ra rak+sha rā tsa'i tsit+ta zungs: kha rag sma sha rā tsa'i tsit+ta rbad: 'khun dum bur shig shig: bha na rak+sha rā tsa'i tsit+ta phyungs: ldog na rak+sha rā tsa'i tsit+ta rbad: tri'u gtub gtub rbad: tsit+ta hu lu hu lu rbad: tsit+ta rak+sha gtub gtub: tri'u tri'u sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ trig naṃ hur thums dza mā ra ya rbad: sre mo'i thod bcug sngon dmar skud pas bcing: sngags bzlas thun brab mal 'og tu mnan pas: rgyal bsen dam sri shi dang khyad par med: : ma mo gnad dbab shi sa bstan pa ni: khyim bya nag po'i pags par gri khrag bris: ma ma ru lu trag pa tsa dam la 'dus: snying la 'dus: srog la 'dus: sa ma ya rak+mo dam la 'dus dza: yu kā li sing dza: ma ma tsit+ta kha rag ma ya sa ma ya dam dza: ma ma ru lu ru lu sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ trig naṃ: hur thums mā ra ya rbad: mdzo rwa nang bcug skud pa sngon dmar bsdam: sngags stong bzlas la thun brab mal 'og mnan: ma mo ma lus shi dang khyad par med: : gza' yi gnad dbab shi sa bstan par bya: me long chu btab mer bsros zil pa dang:

de pho'i khrag gis shog bur 'di bri 'o: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bi sha mu khe du ru ma shi ka dza: pa ti rā hu la dza: hri sho sa ma ye 'ur 'ur sod sod yaṃ yaṃ gar+bha nā ga pa la rā hu la sa ma ya trig rbud khug dza: sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ trig nan hur thums sod: de pho'i thod bcug sngon dmar srad bus bcing: sngags stong bzlas la thun brab mal 'og mnan: de yis gza' nyid shi dang khyad par med: : bdud kyi gnad dbab shi sa bstan par bya: kyung ka'i khrag gis g.yag gi snying shun bris: a yang 'dre yeng sad dha le shi dza: du du ru tra rbad: ru tra dam la 'dus tsa pa la kā la dza: dun dun rbad: daṃ daṃ yaṃ yaṃ duṃ bu yang sa ma ya duṣ+ṭaṃ trig nan hur thums mā ra ya rbad: kyung ka'i thod bcug thun brab them 'og mnan: de yis ru tra shi dang khyad par med: : za 'dre bse rag shi sa bstan pa ni: rin chen mtshal gyis nag po'i dar la bri: su thun kha thun pra ma thun: gaṃ pa dza tri yaṃ tri yaṃ du la sod kha chod kha thaṃ kha thaṃ rbad duṣ+ṭaṃ trig nan hur thums dza mā ra ya rbad: rtsangs pa'i gsob bam ri bong thod pa ru: sdig pa'i ro dang lhan bcug bong bu khyi'i: mjug ma'i spu'i skud bcings la sngags stong bzlas: thun brab them 'og la mnan shi dang mtshungs: : btsan gyi shi sa bstan pa 'di lta ste: bse khrab byang bur mtshal gyis bri bar bya: tri mthar raṃ bcus bskor mthar sngags 'di 'o: tsa sho saṃ pa ra du tri ya dza ran+te dun ma tri pra ma ni dza: tsa tsa tsa ra tsa naṃ tri pra ma ya sa ma ya dam thing li myog rbad shi tri rbad: ru tri rbud rbud dza ya dam thing li myog rbad: sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ trig nan hur thums rbad: rta dmar thod bcug sngon dmar skud pas bcing: mi ra khyi rta'i tshil dud bdug sngags stong: bzlas la thun brab btsan gnas ri zur sba: : klu yi shi sa shog bur nya khrag gis: nā ga hu ya kar ko dza: nā ga duṃ hu ya karko dza: phu nā ga tsit+ta rbad:

sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ trig nan mā ra ya rbad: kham sar sbal gzugs gnyis sbyor bar du bcug: sngon dmar skud bcing sngags stong thun gyis brab: chu mig tu mnan shi dang khyad par med: : thul rtags ngu dang phyag 'tshal byung rmis na: khrus bya bcing khrol bde ba'i dmigs pa ni: rten la bya zhing bskang bshags 'os pa bya: nang rgyas dang ni shin tu 'khu na gnad: dbab la gzhan du mi bya gnyan pas so: de ltar spyi chings zab gnyan man ngag ni: zhar byung yongs rdzogs 'di ni gu ru yi: gsung la zin bris mtsho rgyal bdag gis byas: gter kha 'ga' la sbas kyang 'di nyid zab: them du ma bstan gud sbas gsang ba gnad: sa ma yā: rgyaḥrgyaḥrgyaḥrgyaḥrgyaḥrgyaḥrgya:
bdag rol pa'i rdo rjes gdan drangs so/// /
